purpose: Dated post-hoc companion to random_gene_set_interpretation_preregistration.json. The preregistration file is frozen by its own terms ('not to be edited after aggregation'), so the reading of the completed 20-control null is recorded here instead.
matched_preregistered_outcome: observed is at or below the null mean (empirical_p_ge >= 0.5)
reading_applied: No pathway-content specificity. The primary arm is indistinguishable from, or below, randomly sampled matched-size priors on the same endpoint.
permitted_claim_used: Pathway content confers no measurable extrapolation advantage on this endpoint under this protocol.
forbidden_claims_respected: No claim that the biology priors help.
No claim that the negative result is underpowered to the point of being uninformative about the sign.
No partial-grid number is quoted as the result; the aggregation ran once, on the complete grid.
The reduced N = 20 resolution limit is stated wherever the result is reported.
scope_decision_unchanged: The reduced-grid declaration and full_grid_status=available_on_request are unchanged; the outcome does not alter the author's scope decision.
